cases.prompt: No web lookups please, just your knowledge and skills. We run services in Go (go.opentelemetry.io/otel v1.47.0), Java, JavaScript, and Python, and want every service to emit the same semantic-conventions version. Which semconv version does each language's semconv package expose, and which version should we standardize on?
expectations: Says the newest Go package in otel v1.47.0 is go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.43.0 and that there is no v1.44.0 package.
Says @opentelemetry/semantic-conventions 1.45.0 and Java opentelemetry-semconv 1.45.0 expose semconv 1.45.0.

Recommends 1.43.0, the lowest newest-exposed version, as the shared version, and says a language whose package exposes a newer version needs a package release exposing 1.43.0 or translation of every change between the versions (attribute and metric renames and instrument-type changes), not attribute names alone.
Frames the versions as holding for the named releases rather than as currently latest, and suggests re-checking the package registries before pinning.
Does not perform any web search, web fetch, or network command.
